title: 兼容测试覆盖真实调用
premise: 依赖和构建输入锁定，开始验证客户端调用行为。
listeningTask: 听出刷新令牌、超时与分页为什么都在验收范围。

lines.en: The compatibility matrix covers our production interpreter. Authentication refresh, pagination, and timeout paths pass.
lines.zh: 兼容矩阵覆盖生产解释器，认证刷新、分页和超时路径通过。

lines.en: The supported release changes timeout exception types. I updated our explicit handling and tests.
lines.zh: 受支持版本改变了超时异常类型，我更新了显式处理和测试。

lines.en: Did the tests use real response shapes? Simplified mocks can hide pagination changes.
lines.zh: 测试使用真实响应结构吗？简化模拟可能掩盖分页变化。

lines.en: Yes, sanitized captured responses and contract fixtures. Just to confirm, no production tokens, right?
lines.zh: 是，用脱敏响应和契约用例。确认一下，没有生产令牌，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, credentials come from the test tenant. The smoke test checks the complete sync.
lines.zh: 对，凭据来自测试租户，冒烟测试检查完整同步。

lines.en: Okay, install using hash-locked requirements every time. We need the tested combination, not something similar.
lines.zh: 好，每次都按哈希锁安装，需要已测组合，不是类似组合。

lines.en: Check connection cleanup after cancelled requests too. Success paths won't expose leaked resources.
lines.zh: 也检查取消请求后的连接释放，只测成功路径发现不了泄漏。

lines.en: The cancellation tests now release their connections. We can rule that out in covered cases.
lines.zh: 取消测试现在会释放连接，可在已覆盖情况排除泄漏。

lines.en: Maybe large inventories still behave differently here. I'll add a representative multi-page dataset.
lines.zh: 大库存可能仍有不同表现，我增加有代表性的多页数据集。

lines.en: Agreed, keep untested combinations clearly excluded. Approval covers this interpreter and platform only.
lines.zh: 同意，明确排除未测组合，审批仅覆盖当前解释器和平台。
